_comment: Spring groups of the secondary-motion bake (tools/herogen/anim/secondary.py, HEROES_V2.md 13.6). 'chain': links solved root first, each pointing at the next link's pivot (the last at 'tip'); 'bones': independent links pointing along 'tip' ('mirror_x' flips its x on the hero's right side). stiffness 0-1 sets the frequency (0.8 + 3.5 x stiffness Hz), damping 0-1 the damping ratio (0.8 x damping); limit caps the turn away from the authored pose in degrees and lag (default: limit) the swing behind the spring's target; hang (0-1) pulls the tip toward its bind direction in the world, like gravity (wide sleeves, capes, ponytails), and hang_fade [lo, hi] fades that pull out as the cosine between the carried and the bind direction falls from hi to lo (a bell sleeve stays around a forearm raised overhead instead of standing off it as a disc). Bones a hero lacks are skipped (GeckoLib ignores keys for missing bones).
